title: AgileRadar Design System
intro: A premium, minimalist corporate UI designed for high information density, featuring cyan neon accents and an agile component framework for bidding proposal scouting.

primary.name: Navy Dark
primary.usage: Primary background color and key structural layout elements

secondary.name: Cyan Neon
secondary.usage: Interactive accent color. Coincidence ratings (match_score), active buttons, and hover indicators

gold.name: Amber
gold.usage: Bids under review and medium-scored opportunities

card.name: Slate Surface
card.usage: Bidding opportunity cards on the board

text.name: Text Off-White
text.usage: Primary proposal text and column titles

textMuted.name: Text Soft Gray
textMuted.usage: Budget amounts, closing dates, and client reference labels

success.name: Success Teal
success.usage: High-fit opportunity scoring (>=90%) and submitted states

hierarchy.name: Column Title
hierarchy.usage: Kanban board column headers (Opportunities, In Review...)

hierarchy.name: Match Badge
hierarchy.usage: Percentage of compatibility evaluated by the AI
